about.contact: For source suggestions, corrections or takedown requests, open a GitHub Issue. This site does not republish full posts or handle licensing on behalf of authors.
about.description: An index of engineering blogs from Chinese tech teams, metadata only.
about.footerBody: Subscribe to new entries, or suggest a missing team.
about.footerTitle: Engineering writing, kept in an index.
about.imageCredit: Drawing: Blueprint for Spectacle Reef Lighthouse, public domain.
about.intro: Boguan gathers posts from the engineering blogs of Chinese internet companies in one place. Browse by company, topic or year, or search titles and bodies. Every card links to the original post; full posts are never republished here.
about.license: The site code is released under the MIT license. Indexed posts remain the property of their authors and companies.
about.policy: Pages render only the title, a summary of up to 200 characters, author, publish date, tags and a link to the original. Bodies are used solely for the crawler-side search index and never appear on pages or in search results.
about.scopeBody: Only hand-checked public sources are indexed. Browse by company, topic or year, then search titles and bodies.
about.sources: Only public sources that have been checked by hand are enabled. The crawler honors robots.txt, keeps one request per origin and waits at least one second between requests. It never sends login state and never bypasses paywalls, CAPTCHAs or anti-bot measures.
